comfort: Conditions are in the comfort band. Continue regular monitoring.
watch: THI is in the watch band. Check ventilation, shade and drinking water.
heat_risk: THI is in the heat-risk band. Check the pigs, ventilation, shade and water, and follow your farm's cooling routine.
not_configured: THI bands are not configured yet; ask the farm administrator to set them.
insufficient_data: Not enough sensor data for an assessment. Check that the sensor is online.
unavailable: The latest reading failed data-quality checks. Check the sensor before relying on it.

labels.disclaimer: Advisory decision support only. This is not a veterinary diagnosis.
